title: Wasteland Drifter
genre: Isometric Survival RPG (Cổ điển), Action-Adventure, Strategy.
setting: Thế giới tận thế năm 202X, khi xuất hiện đại dịch xác sống. Trái đất trở thành một vùng đất hoang tàn, khô khốc với những tàn tích rỉ sét của nền văn minh cũ. Con người co cụm trong các thành phố làm từ container. Nguồn nước sạch và đạn dược là thứ quý giá nhất. Những tháp radio cũ và các hầm ngầm quân sự là nơi ẩn chứa những bí mật về nguồn gốc virus.
coreLoop: Khám phá vùng đất hoang > Tiêu diệt Zombie để bảo vệ bản thân (Kills) > Thu thập nhu yếu phẩm và tiền cổ (Cash) > Giao dịch trang bị tại các khu định cư > Tuyển mộ người đồng hành (Followers) > Mở rộng tầm ảnh hưởng và tìm kiếm vùng đất an toàn hơn.
tone: U tối, gai góc (Gritty), tuyệt vọng nhưng xen lẫn sự mỉa mai (Black Humor). Hình ảnh chủ đạo là màu nâu của đất cát, màu xám của bê tông đổ nát và màu xanh neon mờ nhạt của các thiết bị điện tử cũ

structure.title: The Ashen Wastes
structure.summary: The Ashen Wastes is a desolate, barren land characterized by gray landscapes and an eerie silence, where remnants of the old world lie buried under layers of ash. Survivors scavenge the ruins of former civilization, battling mutated wildlife and the undead. This region serves as the starting point of the protagonist's journey, revealing the dire nature of the world and introducing key factions that influence the overarching narrative.

chapters.title: Grey Haven
chapters.description: In this forgotten city, players must gather resources while surviving against waves of zombies that inhabit the ruins. Upon entering the city, they discover a hidden resistance group fighting against an oppressive gang hoarding vital supplies. This event sets the tone for player choices that affect alliances throughout the game.

chapters.title: The Silent Tomb
chapters.description: An abandoned military base that houses echoes of the past. Players venture into a maze-like underground bunker, full of traps and enemies. Here, they uncover crucial documents detailing the origins of the zombie virus and a hidden cache of weapons, which may change the course of their battle against the undead.

chapters.title: The Ashen Festival
chapters.description: A chaotic gathering of various survivor factions that leads to dramatic confrontations and negotiations. Players can participate in mini-games and side quests that can either foster alliances or ignite conflicts, significantly altering diplomatic relations between regions.

structure.title: The Rusted Coast
structure.summary: A coastal area littered with shipwrecks and remnants of maritime cities where pirates and marauding gangs dominate. As the protagonist seeks to expand their influence, they must navigate through treachery and form unlikely alliances with factions that control the waters. This region challenges players with choices that test their strategies and combat skills.

chapters.title: Port Hellion
chapters.description: A thriving, dangerous port where factions clash. Players engage in a fierce battle for control of vital shipping routes. They can choose to side with a pirate faction or help an oppressed trading guild, affecting the dynamics of power in the Rusted Coast.

chapters.title: Shipwreck Cove
chapters.description: An exploration of a submerged city where players uncover relics from the past, including technology that could potentially combat the undead. However, a powerful sea monster complicates their journey, leading to intense underwater combat scenarios.

chapters.title: The Captain's Gambit
chapters.description: A high-stakes negotiation mission with treacherous pirates aboard a ghost ship. Successful diplomacy can yield boat resources and new allies, while failure may result in betrayal and open warfare.

structure.title: The Cracked Plains
structure.summary: An arid landscape riddled with craters and windswept ruins where nomadic tribes roam. This region delves deep into the struggle for survival, where the influence of the environment tests players' survival instincts and relationships with tribal factions. The story arc here focuses on ancient technology and forgotten lore.

chapters.title: Nomad's Cross
chapters.description: A potential trading hub where players must mediate between warring tribes. This chapter is crucial for establishing trade routes and unlocking ancient secrets that would aid in defeating zombies.

chapters.title: Ruins of the Ancients
chapters.description: A mysterious ancient site filled with remnants of pre-apocalyptic technology. Player interactions here can yield powerful artifacts but also awaken ancient guardians that threaten their mission.

chapters.title: The Sandstorm Siege
chapters.description: A major defensive battle against a horde of zombies during a ferocious sandstorm. Players must build defenses with their allies, showcasing strategic planning and teamwork as survivors band together for mutual protection.

structure.title: The Frozen Wastes
structure.summary: A treacherous, frozen expanse filled with blizzards, zombie remnants, and ancient strongholds. This region is critical for its unique climate, which affects gameplay mechanics and introduces a race against time to uncover essential lore about the virus's creation. Players must forge alliances under harsh conditions while battling not only the undead but landscapes as well.

chapters.title: The Ice Fortress
chapters.description: A labyrinthine stronghold where a frostbitten faction possesses knowledge of the virus's origins. Players must navigate icy corridors, overcome winter-themed challenges, and negotiate with the faction leaders for vital information.

chapters.title: The Abandoned Settlement
chapters.description: Once a bustling community, now overrun by snowstorms and zombies. Players explore the town to stumble upon old research labs containing critical data on combating the undead. This location forces characters to confront the consequences of humanity's past mistakes.

chapters.title: The Frostbite Battle
chapters.description: An exhilarating battle scenario at the peak of a mountain where survivors must unite against a massive zombie onslaught taking advantage of the blizzard. This pivotal event leads to the potential unification of factions within the frozen wasteland.

structure.title: The Heart of Ruin
structure.summary: The final region, a sprawling urban wasteland where humanity's last stand takes place. This area is filled with conflicting factions vying for control over the last remaining resources. Here, players uncover the truth behind the virus, the connections between various regions, and face their biggest challenges yet. Choices made throughout the game culminate in this high-stakes environment.

chapters.title: City of Echoes
chapters.description: The central city where all factions converge. Players must navigate the political landscape to forge a decisive alliance, with tasks involving espionage, sabotage, and rescuing key figures to tip the scales in their favor.

chapters.title: The Final Lab
chapters.description: An intense confrontation occurs here where the origin of the zombie virus is revealed. Players can choose to either cure the infection or weaponize it. The choices made will have lasting consequences on the game's ending.

chapters.title: The Rising Dawn
chapters.description: The ultimate battle for humanity’s survival takes place. Players form alliances with characters met throughout their journey to fend off a colossal undead monstrosity. Decisions made throughout the game's arc will determine not only the outcome of the battle but also the future of civilization.
